en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab narrated to us. He said: Al-Nadr b. Shu`ayb narrated to us from Khalid b. al-Qalanisi from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as).

He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: When I rise to the Praiseworthy Station (al-maqam al-mahmud), I will intercede for those who have committed major sins from my Nation; so, Allah will accept my intercession of them. By Allah, I will not intercede for those who harm my offspring.
